parties: SecMark Consultancy Limited (transferee); Codifi Finserv Private Limited and SecMark Holding Private Limited (transferors)
headline: SecMark Consultancy Limited board approves three-way amalgamation scheme
sum: SecMark Consultancy Limited has approved a scheme of amalgamation to merge Codifi Finserv Private Limited and SecMark Holding Private Limited into itself. The merger was approved by the Board on 12 August 2026, following statutory notice requirements under the Companies Act.
implication: Three-way amalgamations require careful sequencing of NCLT sanction petitions and consideration of inter-company guarantees; the transferee structure (SecMark CL as the surviving entity) suggests a consolidation of subsidiary financial-services operations into the parent listed company.
detail: SecMark Consultancy Limited, a listed entity on NSE, approved a scheme of amalgamation under Section 230 of the Companies Act, 2013, whereby two private subsidiaries—Codifi Finserv Private Limited (likely a fintech/lending entity) and SecMark Holding Private Limited (a holding company)—are being merged into the listed parent. The scheme was approved at a Board meeting held on 12 August 2026. This is a common structure in financial services to consolidate operations and simplify the group's legal architecture. NCLT sanction and creditor/shareholder approval remain pending.
